title: A message sent to a session that is still starting reaches it

fields.why: Found in the swap proof run: two of four messages pasted ~25s after launch never reached the agent

text: Driven app run (docs/session-swap-proof.md): TerminalSession.submit pasted messages ~25 s after launch; beta's and delta's never reached their transcripts, alpha's and gamma's did. No state.json yet, so confirmDeliveries had no transcript and never retyped. Impact: a genlock tell or opening message to a fresh session can vanish. Repro: GENLOCK_APP_DRIVE, split 4 projects, submitNth each ~25 s later, check ~/.claude/projects transcripts.
